title: Khilona Ltd. plans to diversify
body: Khilona Ltd. makes a popular brand of soft toys and has a good market reputation. It has a functional organisation structure with separate departments for Production, Marketing, Finance, Human Resources and Research and Development, all reporting to the Managing Director. To use its brand name and cash in on a new and growing market, the company now plans to manufacture a range of electronic toys. Electronic toys need different machines, raw materials and technical staff, and are sold through different shops to older children. The Managing Director is worried that if the electronic toys perform badly, it will be hard to say which department is to blame, and that decisions on the new range may be delayed because they must pass through every functional head. A consultant has suggested a change in the structure of the company.
